case.name: LC4_sensitivity_anchor_swap
case.distribution: Uniform vector surface traction, integrated using 7-point quadratic-triangle shape functions; total resultant normalized to specified N.
case.surface_selection: Only outward upward facets within 0.15 mm of the analytic outer crown reference; internal cross-tie tops excluded.

material.model: homogeneous isotropic linear elastic; not measured printed PLA

mesh.corner_tet_mean_ratio_definition: 12*(3V)^(2/3)/sum(six squared edge lengths); regular tetrahedron=1, degenerate=0. Corner geometry diagnostic only.
mesh.quadratic_jacobian_check: Four C3D10 integration points and centroid; all positive. This is not a formal interval proof at every point.

extra_cases.p95_definition: 95th percentile of integration-point von Mises stress weighted by actual C3D10 Jacobian quadrature volume; avoids overweighting locally tiny elements.
extra_cases.auxiliary_stress_scope: Diagnostic only: removes element-centroid regions within 3 mm of the minimum horizontal point anchors, which can create stress singularities. The global maximum remains separately reported and is not replaced for a strength claim.
extra_cases.interpretation: Bilateral Z supports model a supported/held test fixture. Negative net foot reaction indicates lift-off for a free unbonded mouse; that case is not a valid all-five-feet contact prediction. Peak stresses near constraints/load edges may be singular; p95 is a convergence diagnostic, not a strength substitute.
